Package at.campus02.bsd

Klasse DrinkQueue

java.lang.Object
at.campus02.bsd.DrinkQueue
public class DrinkQueue extends Object
Queue implementation for managing Drink objects. Stores drinks in FIFO (first-in-first-out) order.
